predecessors.name: Oyo Empire
predecessors.text: south of Oyo-Ile: 'the Oyo royal family fled southward to establish a new capital at Oyo Atiba (New Oyo)' (Old Oyo page); 'the capital moved south to Ago d'Oyo' (Oyo page)

successors.name: Niger Coast Protectorate
successors.text: the Alafin's Oyo, in the protectorate over Yorubaland that was 'incorporated into the new Southern Nigeria Protectorate in February 1906'

ledger.x: 1835: the Alaafin's court re-forms at New Oyo.
3 February 1893: the Alaafin accepts British protection.
28 February 1906: the protectorate over Oyo merges into Southern Nigeria.
February 1906: New Oyo ends as a protected state.

certainty.note: No page gives the Alaafin's boundary: the shape is two discs.
